description: Use before onboarding, paying or contracting a company: official register data (as /v1/company), screening of the name against the EU, UN, US OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists (refreshed daily) and official insolvency notices (FR BODACC, UK, CH). Sanctions hits are 'possible matches' with a 0-100 score, never a verdict. Input: name= (+country=), id=, lei= or vat=. Bad input: 400 before payment; outages not charged. Price: 0.02 USDC per successful call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. FR, NO, FI, LV, IE, GB, US, EE, TW, HK, SG, AU, HR, CH, LT, CZ, AT, GR: official national register; other countries: GLEIF.

id.description: National register number, needs country= (same as /v1/company).

name.description: Company legal name (2-200 chars). Screened even if no register knows it.

vat.description: VAT number (FR, NO, FI, LV, HR, CH, CZ, GR), same as /v1/company.

name: kyb
title: Company Check (KYB: sanctions + insolvency)
